title: Backend Engineer
description: Build and maintain HTTP APIs with Python and FastAPI. Design SQL schemas, write queries against PostgreSQL, and ship services in Docker. You will own request validation, database access, and production endpoints for a resume-matching product.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Lead a Django monolith that serves authenticated web traffic. Improve SQL query plans, cache hot reads in Redis, and deploy on AWS. Mentor engineers on service boundaries and operational readiness.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Implement product UI in React and CSS. Translate design specs into accessible components, manage layout and styling, and collaborate with designers on interaction details for a customer dashboard.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: Own the design system and Next.js application architecture. Set TypeScript standards, review component APIs, and integrate GraphQL clients used across marketing and app surfaces.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build batch ETL pipelines. Transform warehouse tables with SQL, process large datasets in Spark, and schedule jobs in Airflow on AWS. Focus on idempotent loads and data quality checks.

title: Data Analyst
description: Answer business questions with SQL, Excel models, and Tableau dashboards. Publish weekly metrics, document metric definitions, and partner with operations on reporting requests.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Train and evaluate PyTorch models for ranking and classification. Define offline metrics, prepare feature tables, and deploy batch scoring jobs. Partner with product on machine learning use cases.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Run container platforms. Package services with Docker, operate Kubernetes clusters, and harden Linux hosts. Maintain CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure on AWS.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Ship features across a Node.js API and a React client. Design PostgreSQL tables, review pull requests, and keep local Docker environments reproducible for the team.

title: Java Backend Engineer
description: Develop Spring services in Java. Model relational data with SQL, publish domain events to Kafka, and containerize workloads with Docker for a payments ledger.

title: QA Engineer
description: Write automated test suites in pytest. Validate API behavior, check SQL fixtures, and wire suites into CI/CD on Linux runners. File clear defects and guard regressions.

title: UI Engineer
description: Turn Figma files into responsive HTML and CSS. Match spacing and typography, hand off assets, and pair with frontend engineers when interactions need JavaScript.

title: Junior Python Developer
description: Fix bugs in internal Python scripts and write small utilities. Learn the team's Git workflow and pair with senior engineers on code review.

title: Flask API Engineer
description: Extend a Flask service that exposes REST endpoints for an inventory system. Add request handlers, SQL access, and Docker packaging for local runs.

title: Vue Developer
description: Build customer account pages in Vue and CSS. Connect screens to REST APIs and keep the JavaScript state predictable across the account flow.

title: Angular Developer
description: Deliver Angular features for an internal admin console. Use TypeScript, HTML templates, and CSS to ship form-heavy workflows.

title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: Ship marketing and app pages with React and Tailwind. Keep components reusable and align spacing with the published design system.

title: Node.js API Engineer
description: Implement REST handlers in Node.js. Shape JSON contracts, query PostgreSQL, and run the service locally with Docker.

title: Data Scientist
description: Build classical machine learning models with scikit-learn. Prepare feature tables in SQL and Python, and explain model behavior to product partners.

title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Support training runs and evaluation notebooks. Clean datasets in Python and help compare machine learning baselines before a model is promoted.

title: Database Administrator
description: Administer PostgreSQL clusters. Tune SQL, plan indexes, and support a smaller MongoDB footprint used by product analytics.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Model operational metrics in SQL and publish Power BI reports. Reconcile figures in Excel and share metric definitions with finance.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Own production reliability for services on Kubernetes and AWS. Respond to incidents on Linux hosts and reduce toil with Terraform.

title: Security Engineer
description: Review cloud configurations on AWS, hunt misconfigurations on Linux, and automate checks with Python. Partner with platform teams on Kubernetes hardening.
